image_description: A male mallard duck (drake) floating on blue water. The duck features a characteristic iridescent green head, a white neck ring, a brown/grey chest and body, and a dark tail with curled feathers. The bill is yellow-green with a black tip. The reflection of the duck is visible in the water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Most distinctive feature is the broad, flat bill adapted for filter-feeding; bill is dark grey to yellow-green.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bill is clearly visible, broad, flat, and exhibits the correct yellow-green coloration with a dark tip typical of a mallard drake.
The eye is visible and appears dark/black, consistent with the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is stocky and compact, streamlined and buoyant with dense waterproof plumage.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body shape is appropriately streamlined for swimming, sitting low in the water. The plumage texture appears dense and waterproof.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Breeding plumage is typically more colorful than female: common patterns include iridescent green head with white neck ring and grey body (mallard), or chestnut head with grey body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image displays the classic mallard drake pattern: iridescent green head, distinct white neck ring, and brownish-grey body plumage.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are short and set far back on the body with webbed feet (three forward toes connected by webbing).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The duck is floating on water; the legs and feet are submerged and completely occluded from view.
The folded wings are visible along the side of the body, appearing broad and structurally sound, though the 'pointed' nature is less obvious when folded.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is short with curled central tail feathers (drake feathers) in many species.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible at the rear, and the characteristic upward curl of the central tail feathers (drake feathers) is clearly present.
